definitions.explanation: The period during which a war is being fought. In Japanese contexts most often refers to World War II (specifically the wartime years from the late 1930s to 1945), but can also describe any ongoing war.

examples.japanese: {戦時中|せんじちゅう}は{食料|しょくりょう}が{足|た}りなかった。
examples.english: Food was in short supply during the war.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{戦時中|せんじちゅう}の{思|おも}い{出|で}をよく{話|はな}してくれた。
examples.english: My grandmother often told me about her memories from the war years.

examples.japanese: {戦時中|せんじちゅう}は{言論|げんろん}の{自由|じゆう}が{厳|きび}しく{制限|せいげん}されていた。
examples.english: During the war, freedom of speech was severely restricted.

notes:
{戦時|せんじ} (wartime) + {中|ちゅう} (during, in the middle of). Functions as a temporal noun, often used adverbially as {戦時中|せんじちゅう}に.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦時中|せんじちゅう}の{生活|せいかつ}: life during the war
- {戦時中|せんじちゅう}の{記憶|きおく}: memories of the war
- {戦時中|せんじちゅう}に{生|う}まれる: to be born during the war
- {戦時中|せんじちゅう}{下|か}で: under wartime conditions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {戦中|せんちゅう}: wartime — shorter literary variant with the same meaning
- {戦前|せんぜん}: prewar — refers to the period before the war
- {戦後|せんご}: postwar — refers to the period after the war
